id: 35_What is the difference between BSL-1, BSL-2, BSL-3 and BSL-4 Biosafety levels bi
title: 一张表看懂四个防护等级
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/35_What is the difference between BSL-1, BSL-2, BSL-3 and BSL-4 Biosafety levels bi.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/35_What is the difference between BSL-1, BSL-2, BSL-3 and BSL-4 Biosafety levels bi/src.py

points.K1: 生物安全：安全操作，牢牢封闭
points.K3: 防实验室感染，防意外释放
points.K4: 防护等级：一套标准化的封闭措施
points.K5: 按危害定程序、设备、设施
points.S1: 国内病原四类：数字越小越危险
points.S2: 等级要整套配齐，缺一项不达标
points.S3: 离心防气溶胶：密封杯，柜内开

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一张大表格前，表头四格依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a large blank table whose four header cells light up one by one.
shots.narration: 一到四级防护等级，到底差在哪？
overlay: 一张表看懂四个防护等级

shots.scene: 表格左列七个空格，旁边七个小图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank table with seven rows; each row starts with a small icon: a germ, a petri dish, a door, gloves, a cabinet, a building, and floating droplets. No people.
shots.narration: 今天用七行，把它们比一比。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着两张不同实验室的空白准入表，一脸困惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds two blank access forms from two different labs, looking confused.
shots.narration: 阿杰要去两个实验室帮忙。

shots.scene: 两扇门上的生物危害标志颜色不同
shots.prompt_en: Two lab doors side by side, each with a biohazard warning sign, one pale yellow and one orange. No people.
shots.narration: 一间是一级，一间是二级。

shots.scene: 小研拿出一张空白对比表，在桌上摊开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student spreads a blank comparison table on a desk in front of the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研说：咱们画张表就明白了。

shots.section_title: 生物安全：安全操作，牢牢封闭
shots.scene: 生物危害标志在中间，四周是微生物和防护图标
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard warning sign in the center of a wheel, surrounded by icons of bacteria, viruses, gloves and a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 先说什么是生物安全。
overlay: 生物安全：安全操作，牢牢封闭

shots.section_title: 生物安全：安全操作，牢牢封闭
shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里稳稳地操作培养物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calmly handles a culture inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 就是安全地操作感染性材料，

shots.section_title: 生物安全：安全操作，牢牢封闭
shots.scene: 一个容器被层层围住的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a sealed container surrounded by several protective layers. No people.
shots.narration: 并把它们牢牢封闭在里面。

shots.scene: 规程本、操作手势、生物安全柜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank procedure binder, a gloved hand, and a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 靠规范、程序和设备，

shots.scene: 操作者、树木、城市三个图标被罩住
shots.prompt_en: A lab worker icon, a tree icon and a city icon, all under one protective dome. No people.
shots.narration: 保护个人、环境和公众。

shots.section_title: 防实验室感染，防意外释放
shots.scene: 人形图标旁的病菌被挡在盾牌外
shots.prompt_en: A germ icon blocked by a shield before it reaches a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一要防止实验室获得性感染，
overlay: 防实验室感染，防意外释放

shots.section_title: 防实验室感染，防意外释放
shots.scene: 病菌想从门缝溜出，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A germ icon trying to slip out under a lab door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 二要防止病原意外释放出去。

shots.section_title: 防护等级：一套标准化的封闭措施
shots.scene: 四级台阶，每级一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A four-step staircase with a shield on each step. No people.
shots.narration: 防护等级，是一套标准化的封闭措施，
overlay: 防护等级：一套标准化的封闭措施

shots.section_title: 防护等级：一套标准化的封闭措施
shots.scene: 四级台阶从浅黄到深红
shots.prompt_en: The four steps are colored from pale yellow at the bottom to deep red at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 从一级到四级，逐级加严。

shots.section_title: 按危害定程序、设备、设施
shots.scene: 放大镜照着一个微生物图标，旁边一个刻度表
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a microbe icon, next to a hazard gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 定哪一级，看所研究生物的危害。
overlay: 按危害定程序、设备、设施

shots.section_title: 按危害定程序、设备、设施
shots.scene: 程序、设备、设施三个图标连到台阶上
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a procedure binder, a cabinet and a building, connected by lines to the staircase. No people.
shots.narration: 级别决定程序、设备和设施要求。

shots.scene: 表格第一行亮起，四格颜色由浅到深
shots.prompt_en: The first row of the table lights up; its four cells shade from pale to deep red. No people.
shots.narration: 第一行，比病原风险。

shots.scene: 一级格：健康的笑脸人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Cell one: a smiling healthy person icon next to an ordinary dish. No people.
shots.narration: 一级：不使健康人致病。

shots.scene: 二级格：生病的人形图标和药片
shots.prompt_en: Cell two: a person icon with a thermometer next to a pill. No people.
shots.narration: 二级：能致病，但一般可治。

shots.scene: 三级格：空气中飘浮的微粒和病床
shots.prompt_en: Cell three: tiny particles floating in the air and a hospital bed icon. No people.
shots.narration: 三级：可经空气传播，后果严重。

shots.scene: 四级格：警示三角和空药箱
shots.prompt_en: Cell four: a red warning triangle and an empty medicine box. No people.
shots.narration: 四级：危及生命，缺乏防治手段。

shots.scene: 表格第二行四格，各放一类微生物的剪影
shots.prompt_en: The second row of the table: each cell holds a silhouette of a microbe category, with no names. No people.
shots.narration: 第二行，举例。

shots.scene: 一级格：教学用的无害菌株培养皿
shots.prompt_en: Cell one: a teaching culture dish with a harmless strain icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一级多是无害的实验室菌株，

shots.scene: 二级格：常见致病细菌剪影
shots.prompt_en: Cell two: silhouettes of common rod-shaped and round bacteria. No people.
shots.narration: 二级是常见的、可治疗的致病菌；

shots.scene: 三级、四级格：空气传播和高危病毒的剪影，带红框
shots.prompt_en: Cells three and four: silhouettes of an airborne germ and a high-risk virus, framed in red. No people.
shots.narration: 三四级是严重的空气传播和高危病原。

shots.scene: 小研翻开空白目录，指着一行
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank catalog book and points at one line.
shots.narration: 具体是哪一类，查国家目录。

shots.scene: 表格第三行：四扇门，锁越来越多
shots.prompt_en: The third row: four door icons, each with more locks than the last. No people.
shots.narration: 第三行，谁能进门。

shots.scene: 一级门旁培训证书图标
shots.prompt_en: Door one with a training certificate icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一级：受过培训的人可进；

shots.scene: 二级门有门禁刷卡
shots.prompt_en: Door two with a card reader and a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 二级：限制进入；

shots.scene: 三级门：门禁加专门培训证书
shots.prompt_en: Door three with a card reader and a special training badge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 三级：受控进入，须专门培训；

shots.scene: 四级门：多重门禁，高度安保
shots.prompt_en: Door four with multiple access panels and a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 四级：严格控制，高度安保。

shots.scene: 表格第四行：四个人形，防护越来越多
shots.prompt_en: The fourth row: four person outlines wearing more and more protective gear. No people.
shots.narration: 第四行，个人防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿实验服、戴手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears a lab coat and gloves.
shots.narration: 一级：实验服和手套；

shots.scene: 小研加戴面屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a lab coat, gloves and a face shield.
shots.narration: 二级：再加面部防护；

shots.scene: 全身防护服、呼吸防护图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a full protective gown and a respirator mask with a powered air unit. No people.
shots.narration: 三级：全套防护，加呼吸防护；

shots.scene: 连着供气管的正压防护服图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a positive-pressure full-body suit connected to an air hose. No people.
shots.narration: 四级：带独立供气的正压防护服。

shots.scene: 表格第五行：洗手池、生物安全柜、密闭柜
shots.prompt_en: The fifth row: icons of a hand-washing sink, an open-front biological safety cabinet, and a fully enclosed glove-box cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 第五行，安全设备。

shots.scene: 洗手池和消毒喷壶
shots.prompt_en: A hand-washing sink and a disinfectant spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 一级：洗手和基本消毒；

shots.scene: 生物安全柜前窗下有气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet with airflow arrows at the front opening. No people.
shots.narration: 二级：有风险的操作进二级生物安全柜；

shots.scene: 生物安全柜和密封盖的离心杯
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet next to a sealed centrifuge cup. No people.
shots.narration: 三级：必须用安全柜和密封设备；

shots.scene: 手套箱式密闭柜和正压防护服
shots.prompt_en: A fully enclosed glove-box cabinet next to a positive-pressure suit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 四级：全密闭柜或正压防护服。

shots.scene: 表格第六行：四个房间剖面，越来越复杂
shots.prompt_en: The sixth row: four room cross-sections, each more complex than the last. No people.
shots.narration: 第六行，实验室设计。

shots.scene: 普通实验室和带洗手池、高压灭菌器的实验室
shots.prompt_en: Two room diagrams: a basic lab, and a lab with a sink, an autoclave and a splash shield. No people.
shots.narration: 一级是普通实验室；二级加洗手池和灭菌器。

shots.scene: 空气箭头向内的房间，排风口有过滤器图标
shots.prompt_en: A room diagram with airflow arrows pointing inward and a filter icon on the exhaust. No people.
shots.narration: 三级：负压，排风经高效过滤。

shots.scene: 被几层墙围住的房间，入口有多道门
shots.prompt_en: A room enclosed by several walls, with a series of doors at the entrance and filter icons on both supply and exhaust. No people.
shots.narration: 四级：完全隔离，进出风都过滤。

shots.scene: 表格第七行：飘浮的小液滴
shots.prompt_en: The seventh row: tiny droplets floating in the air. No people.
shots.narration: 第七行，气溶胶控制。

shots.scene: 一级格空白，二级格有个警示标
shots.prompt_en: Cell one is blank; cell two shows a small caution icon over a vortex mixer. No people.
shots.narration: 一级不作要求；二级产生气溶胶时要防。

shots.scene: 三级格：液滴被罩住；四级格：完全封闭的盒子
shots.prompt_en: Cell three: droplets trapped under a dome; cell four: a fully sealed box. No people.
shots.narration: 三级至关重要；四级时刻全封闭。

shots.section_title: 国内病原四类：数字越小越危险
shots.scene: 欣欣举起两张方向相反的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two cards with arrows pointing in opposite directions.
shots.narration: 表格看完，再提醒一个易错点。
overlay: 国内病原四类：数字越小越危险

shots.section_title: 国内病原四类：数字越小越危险
shots.scene: 两排格子：上排四最深，下排一最深
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of four boxes: in the top row the darkest box is on the right, in the bottom row the darkest box is on the left. No people.
shots.narration: 国际危险度分组，四组最危险；

shots.section_title: 国内病原四类：数字越小越危险
shots.scene: 第一类格子最大最红
shots.prompt_en: A row of four boxes; the first box is the biggest and deep red, the fourth is small and pale. No people.
shots.narration: 我国病原分四类，第一类最危险。

shots.section_title: 国内病原四类：数字越小越危险
shots.scene: 两排台阶都向上
shots.prompt_en: Two staircases side by side, both rising from one to four. No people.
shots.narration: 而实验室等级，国内外同向。

shots.section_title: 国内病原四类：数字越小越危险
shots.scene: 高等级实验室门前一个审批印章
shots.prompt_en: An approval stamp icon in front of a high-level lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 第一、二类实验，须经批准。

shots.section_title: 等级要整套配齐，缺一项不达标
shots.scene: 四块拼图：房间、设备、规程、人员，拼成一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Four puzzle pieces, a room, a cabinet, a procedure binder and a person, fit together into a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 七行要求是一整套。
overlay: 等级要整套配齐，缺一项不达标

shots.section_title: 等级要整套配齐，缺一项不达标
shots.scene: 拼图缺了一块，盾牌出现缺口
shots.prompt_en: The same shield with one puzzle piece missing, leaving a gap with a red warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 房子够格，操作不到位，也不算数。

shots.section_title: 等级要整套配齐，缺一项不达标
shots.scene: 王老师拿空白检查表在实验室逐项核对
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the lab ticking items on a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 设施、设备、操作、人员都要查。

shots.section_title: 离心防气溶胶：密封杯，柜内开
shots.scene: 离心机图标和飘起的小液滴
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge icon with tiny droplets rising from an open tube. No people.
shots.narration: 离心，是气溶胶的常见来源。
overlay: 离心防气溶胶：密封杯，柜内开

shots.section_title: 离心防气溶胶：密封杯，柜内开
shots.scene: 小研把离心管装进带密封盖的离心杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places tubes into a centrifuge cup and closes its sealed lid.
shots.narration: 用带盖的密封离心杯，

shots.section_title: 离心防气溶胶：密封杯，柜内开
shots.scene: 小研把离心杯拿进生物安全柜再打开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries the sealed cup into a biological safety cabinet before opening it.
shots.narration: 离心完，拿到安全柜里再开盖。

shots.section_title: 离心防气溶胶：密封杯，柜内开
shots.scene: 离心刚停就在台面开盖的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a centrifuge cup opened on an open bench right after spinning, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要在台面上直接开。

shots.scene: 教学实验室的门，标着一级、二级
shots.prompt_en: Teaching lab doors with pale yellow and orange biohazard warning signs. No people.
shots.narration: 学生实验多在一级、二级实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在高等级实验室门外，门上有审批印章和门禁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops outside a high-level lab door that has an access panel and an approval stamp icon.
shots.narration: 三四级要专门批准、培训、授权。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周请示，老周摇头示意先评估
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man for permission; the older man shakes his head and points to a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 拿不准级别，先问负责人，不擅自做。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在七行表格前，表格整体亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the seven-row table as it lights up completely.
shots.narration: 七行对比，一级比一级严。

shots.scene: 风险、准入、防护三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hazard gauge, a door lock and a face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 风险越高，门越严，防护越多。

shots.scene: 安全柜、负压房间、气溶胶罩三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biological safety cabinet, a negative pressure room and droplets under a dome. No people.
shots.narration: 设备、设计、气溶胶控制层层加码。

shots.scene: 两排方向相反的格子
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of boxes with opposite color order. No people.
shots.narration: 记住：国内病原第一类最危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣在两扇实验室门之间挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye between two lab doors with biohazard warning signs.
shots.narration: 认清级别再进门，下次见！
